headline: RapWire 24/7: five verified hip-hop and GTA VI developments — Oct. 3, 2026
body: RapWire's five-slide original editorial carousel covers Rick Ross's Miami battery case, G Herbo's retirement reversal, OutKast's trademark suit against Ovrkast, GTA VI's mature-content descriptors, and Rockstar's $399.99 Vice City collectible box. Each slide pairs a current verified update with the relevant person, company, court, or game subject so the news context stays readable on the artwork and in the caption.
rendered_body_text: RapWire's five-slide original editorial carousel covers Rick Ross's Miami battery case, G Herbo's retirement reversal, OutKast's trademark suit against Ovrkast, GTA VI's mature-content descriptors, and Rockstar's $399.99 Vice City collectible box. Each slide pairs a current verified update with the relevant person, company, court, or game subject so the news context stays readable on the artwork and in the caption.
caption:
1. Rick Ross (@richforever) surrendered in Miami Beach and faces felony battery-by-strangulation plus misdemeanor battery charges after an ex-partner’s allegations. He was released on $5,000 bond, pleaded not guilty, and has an Oct. 22 arraignment scheduled; the allegations remain unproven.
2. G Herbo (@gherbo) said on Instagram Live that he was retiring from rap because the business was draining, with acting and podcasting as possible next moves. He then walked that back in a follow-up, saying he ain’t ever quit at nothing, so the verified update is a reversal—not a retirement.
3. High Schoolers LLC, the trademark company controlled by André 3000 (@andre3000) and Big Boi (@bigboi), sued Oakland rapper-producer Ovrkast over the similar name and an alleged promise to rebrand as OVERKXST. The complaint seeks relief on trademark, unfair-competition, dilution and contract theories; no court has ruled on the allegations.
4. GTA VI is now listed with an ESRB M rating for Mature 17+ and descriptors including strong sexual content, nudity, violence, drugs and alcohol, language and mature humor. Separate regional ratings also specifically call out sex scenes, making the game’s adult-content profile clearer before its Nov. 19 release.
5. Rockstar opened preorders for a $399.99 Goodtime State–Vice City Collection inspired by Leonida’s fictional TV show Macca the Gator. The 11-piece box includes a gator figure, sunglasses, cap, bag, glassware, pins, stickers and map poster, but the GTA VI game is sold separately and the set ships Nov. 19.

@Rapwire247

slide_editorial_copy.headline:
RICK ROSS
FACES CHARGES
slide_editorial_copy.deck: Ross faces felony and misdemeanor battery counts after an ex-partner’s allegations. He pleaded not guilty, posted $5,000 bond and is due in court Oct. 22; the charges remain allegations.

slide_editorial_copy.headline:
G HERBO
WALKS IT BACK
slide_editorial_copy.deck: After saying on Instagram Live that rap was too draining and he was done, Herbo walked the retirement talk back in a follow-up. Acting and podcasting are still in the conversation, but he says he is not quitting.

slide_editorial_copy.headline:
OUTKAST
VS. OVRKAST
slide_editorial_copy.deck: OutKast’s trademark company says Ovrkast broke a rebrand deal over the similar name. Its federal complaint seeks trademark and contract relief; no ruling has been issued.

slide_editorial_copy.headline:
GTA VI
GETS MATURE
slide_editorial_copy.deck: ESRB lists M for Mature 17+ with violence, nudity, strong sexual content, drugs and alcohol, language and mature humor. Australian and New Zealand listings separately specify “sex scenes,” adding a sharper content signal before the Nov. 19 launch.

slide_editorial_copy.headline:
GTA VI’S
$400 BOX
slide_editorial_copy.deck: The $399.99 box includes Macca the Gator, shades, cap, bag, glassware, pins, stickers and a Leonida map poster. It is merch only—GTA VI is sold separately—and ships Nov. 19 while supplies last.

news_verification.notes: Five distinct non-duplicate current stories; each supported by at least two independent sources, with court claims labeled as allegations.
